# skycloak_domain_routes (Data Source)

Realm routes configured on a custom domain.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "skycloak_domain_routes" "app" {
  cluster_id = skycloak_cluster.production.id
  domain_id  = skycloak_domain.app.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) Cluster ID.
- `domain_id` (String) Domain ID.

### Read-Only

- `routes` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--routes))

<a id="nestedatt--routes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `routes`

Read-Only:

- `allow_admin_access` (Boolean) Whether the admin console is reachable.
- `hide_realm_path` (Boolean) Whether the realm path is hidden.
- `id` (String) Route ID.
- `realm` (String) Realm mapped onto the domain.
